# Google Translate

> Google's free multilingual translation service supporting 100+ languages across web, mobile (Android/iOS), and offline platforms with camera, voice, and document translation capabilities.

Google Translate provides instant translation through various input methods including text, speech, images, and handwriting. The service includes community contribution features to improve translation quality and supports offline translation, conversation mode, and real-time camera translation for travelers and multilingual communication.

## Key Topics

- Camera Translation
- Offline Translation
- Voice Translation
- Document Translation
- Conversation Mode
- Mobile App (Android & iOS)
- Website Translation
- Community Contributions
- 100+ Languages
- Real-time Translation
- Handwriting Recognition
- Phrasebook
- Neural Machine Translation
- Google Account Integration

## Core Product

- [Google Translate](https://translate.google.com): Homepage: translate words, phrases, web pages between 100+ languages
- [Google Translate Community](https://translate.google.com/community): Community translation interface for multilingual contributions
- [Google Translate (Czech)](https://translate.google.com/intl/cs/about/index.html): Google Translate about page in Czech with product overview
- [Google Translate (Polish)](https://translate.google.com/intl/pl/about/index.html): Google Translate about page in Polish with features overview
- [Google Translate (Macedonian)](https://translate.google.com/intl/mk/about/index.html): Google Translate about page in Macedonian with feature overview
- [Google Translate (Hindi)](https://translate.google.com/intl/hi/about/index.html): Google Translate about page in Hindi with translation features
- [Google Translate (Nepali)](https://translate.google.com/intl/ne/about/index.html): Google Translate about page in Nepali with multilingual support
- [Google Translate (Sinhala)](https://translate.google.com/intl/si/about/index.html): Google Translate about page in Sinhala language
